The opponent has more minions and therefore attacks first. All random targets are equally likely, Windfury attacks occur consecutively, and each minion receives only its normal number of attacks. Enumerating every target sequence shows that the hero damage is 7 with probability \(1/6\), 8 with probability \(1/6\), 10 with probability \(1/3\) and 0 otherwise. The resulting expectation is \(35/6\). (Blood-Gem buffs never alter any lethal breakpoints, and the turn-12 damage cap is never reached.)
